reading.summary: A fictional recap, to show what your Claude writes after each close. In this sample session the Nasdaq led while small caps slipped, as the largest platforms rose and rate-sensitive groups gave ground.

points.headline: The Nasdaq led the other indices
points.line: In the sample, its largest platforms rose more than the broad market, while the Dow kept pace with the S&P 500.

points.headline: Utilities and telecoms led the losers
points.line: Rate-sensitive groups were the weakest in the sample, as yields rose through the afternoon.

points.headline: Communication services held up
points.line: The sample's largest platforms closed higher and kept the Nasdaq positive.

points.headline: Small caps fell
points.line: IWM trailed the S&P 500 in the sample session.

holdings.name: NVIDIA Corp
holdings.why: In the sample, chip makers moved after a fictional supplier updated its data-centre outlook, and NVIDIA moved with the group.

holdings.name: Apple Inc
holdings.why: In the sample, a fictional report on handset orders in Asia moved the shares from the open.

holdings.name: Vanguard S&P 500 ETF
holdings.why: Held flat with the S&P 500, as gains in technology offset the defensive groups; no news was about the fund itself.
